summary: Very steep through road, 16% grade, with few parked cars.
reasons: Through road, few cars parked on this kerb

best_section.where: North kerb at the eastern junction of Goldsbrough Road

drivers.seclusion: Homes 13-14 m from the kerb on the same side near the start; more homes 20 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Few cars parked on this kerb; a couple in the lane near the 50 m mark.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the north kerb; no signs.

flags: Homes within 15 m of the best section
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover on the south side; the north kerb is mostly open with tree shade at the east end.
